messages.title: Winter schedule & track updates
messages.summary: Track closed Dec 18; warm-up at Lacroix park.
messages.body: The track is booked for maintenance on Wednesday, Dec 18. We'll meet at Lacroix park, 19:00, for hill reps. Bring headlamps. Tempo block on Saturday stays unchanged.

messages.title: Club night with nutrition Q&A
messages.summary: Short tempo then talk by Coach Alice.
messages.body: Thursday Dec 19: 30' tempo @ 90% VMA then stretch. Afterwards, Coach Alice will host a 20-minute nutrition Q&A in the clubhouse. Please be on time so we can start together.

messages.title: Race weekend logistics
messages.body: For Sunday's 10k, bib pickup closes at 9:30. Carpool from the stadium at 8:10 (drivers: Max, Elise, Julien). If you're late, message the group before 8:00.
